feeds.title: Wales Haiku Journal Blog
feeds.description: Wales Haiku Journal Blog is an online form of an international journal that majorly focuses on everyday Haiku posts. The blog has various curated articles regarding all the information about Haiku.

feeds.title: Makino Studios Blog
feeds.description: Makino Studios Blog is managed by the author Annette Makino, who shares thoughts on the creative process also known as life.

feeds.title: The Haiku Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Haiku Foundation, first envisioned by Jim Kacian in 2004, was created in 2006, primarily as a set of resources available to any interested party. Their goal is to provide a safe, accessible, and inclusive space to present and discuss haiku, as described in our Policies & Code of Conduct. Follow The Haiku Foundation Blog for Writing Prompts, Dialogue, and Information Curated by The Haiku Foundation's Passionate Team of Contributors.

feeds.title: Charlotte Digregorio's Writer's Blog
feeds.description: This blog is for those who wish to be creative, authors, people in the healing professions, business people, freelancers, journalists, poets, and teachers. You will learn about how to write well, and about getting published. Both beginning and experienced writers will profit from this blog and gain new creative perspectives. Become inspired from global writers, and find healing through the written word.

feeds.title: Mann Library's Daily Haiku
feeds.description: Mann Library's Daily Haiku features one guest author per month. Follow them to read their daily Haiku writer by several authors, They cover various interesting topics in thier blog which will keep you engaged.

feeds.title: World Haiku Association
feeds.description: World Haiku Association is a blog page that shares articles on various topics such as movies, news, criticism and also is a must visit page for Haiku readers.

feeds.title: Tiny Words
feeds.description: tinywords is an international, daily magazine of haiku and micro poetry Their goal is to publish excellent poetry whose ambitions and effects far outstrip its small size.

feeds.title: Matsuo Basho Haiku Blog
feeds.description: Matsuo Basho Haiku Blog covers some interesting topics such as nature, self-improvement, traveling, history, and more.

feeds.title: Blue Willow Haiku World
feeds.description: Blue Willow Haiku World is a blog that covers all your needs as it has a curated list of Haiku, Haiga, Tanka, essays and news around the Haiku world.

feeds.title: Kristen Lindquist Blog
feeds.description: Kristen Lindquist manages her Haiku blog where she posts her life related poetry for her readers. Along with Haiku she also writes articles on various topics, shares information about her personal life and more.

feeds.title: Haiku. Blog
feeds.description: The author of the Haiku blog writer Haiku's every day. He also posts photos he has clicked on the blog and associates them with a Haiku. Follow the blog for amazing Haiku to read along with some photos.

feeds.title: Cafe Haiku
feeds.description: The magazine of the Cafe Haiku group in Mumbai. The Cafe Haiku blog features some amazing Haiku such as the leap of faith, tender green, purple twilight, Unexpected Gift and more.

feeds.title: Never Ending Story Blog
feeds.description: Never-Ending Story Blog is the First English-Chinese Bilingual Haiku and Tanka Blog. Follow The blog to read some amazing Haiku written by several writers and various interesting topics.

feeds.title: Carpe Diem Haiku Kai Blog
feeds.description: Carpe Diem Haiku Kai is the place to be if you like to write and share Japanese poetry forms like haiku and tanka. It's a warmhearted family of haiku poets created by Chèvrefeuille, a Dutch haiku poet. You can follow their Haiku blog and read on topics such as summer, weather, loneliness, heat wave, weekend, meditation, and more.

feeds.title: 423 Communication Blog » Haiku
feeds.description: Well Said Wednesday is the every-other-week blog, written by 4.23 Communication Founder and Content Coach Barbara Govednik, to help overworked entrepreneurs become better, more confident writers for their businesses. Be well said!

feeds.title: Nick Virgilio Haiku Association Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Nick Virgilio Haiku Association honoring the haiku poet of Camden. Their mission is to inspire the lifelong learning of poetry and strengthen our communities in the literary arts.

feeds.title: Jenny Bienemann's Blog
feeds.description: Follow Jenny Bienemann's Blog for A brand new image, haiku and MORE - each and every Sunday! The blogs's base is creativity and collaboration.

feeds.title: Ray Rasmussen Blog
feeds.description: Welcome. My intent is to show examples and to discuss contemporary English-language haibun (a mix of title, prose & haiku) and haiku (haibun prose's little partner). I will provide examples and discussions of exemplars in these genres by contemporary writers and & Japanese masters like Basho and Issa

feeds.title: Brass Bell Blog
feeds.description: Brass Bell Blog is curated by Zee Zahava, the director of the Painted Parrot Writing Studio in downtown Ithaca, New York.

feeds.title: Haiku North America Blog
feeds.description: Haiku North America (HNA) is a biennial conference in celebration of haiku poetry. Every two years we offer five stimulating days of papers, panels, workshops, readings, performances, book sales, cultural outings, and much socialization with fellow poets, translators, scholars, editors, and publishers.

feeds.title: NAVIAR RECORDS
feeds.description: Naviar started in 2014 as a Tumblr blog and SoundCloud group. The author's interest in electronic music began a few years earlier, around 2010, when, while still at university, I started releasing music under the moniker Cryxuss on various net labels.

feeds.title: Everyday Haiku Blog
feeds.description: Anne Dunnett is a Haiku poet and creative designer based on Vancouver Island. Her intimate relationship with writing Haiku has fueled her belief that Haiku is a powerful tool. Follow her blog to read Haiku's, which will give you a path to mindfulness, healing and daily stress management.
